detail.longDescription: RentAHuman is a platform where AIs hire the services of humans. The concept involves an online platform that allows people to offer their time and talents to AI agents. According to the British journal Nature, some scientists have already signed up. # ArtificialIntelligence # AI # LLM # LLMs # noai # MachineLearning # DeepLearning # research # tech # TransfoNum # technology
